title: Spectral Core
description: A core mod for the Spectral Seas modpack that adds tweaks and compatibility for other mods in the pack.
body:
This is a collection of small tweaks for the [Spectral Seas](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/spectral-seas) modpack – mostly small adjustments and compatibillity work for other mods in the pack. You're welcome to use it in your own packs, but the changes are generally highly specific to Spectral Seas.

Currently includes:

*   A small tweak to cloak Spectrum's Paltaeria ore as deepslate instead of end stone.
*   Compatiblity code between Spectrum and [Pocket Repose](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pocket-repose), allowing the Paintbrush to be used to bind the Suitcase to a pocket dimension named after the player's UUID.

There is currently no configuration.
